_comment: Aster UI — English catalog, and the fallback when a key is missing from another one (i18n/index.js). Flat keys; {name} is a placeholder.
app.title: Aster
app.subtitle: GSM gateway
login.subtitle: Gateway administration
health.title: Health
overview.title: Overview
overview.no_modems_hint: Scan for devices and assign one — it then appears here.
overview.unassigned_hint: The drivers see them, but no modem owns them.
overview.registry_invalid: config/aster.yaml has problems, so no modem can be listed. Fix it under Config.
modem.radio_off_pending: Off as soon as the modem connects
modem.radio_unsupported: Not controlled (Asterisk without the radio patches)
modem.enabled_hint: When disabled, the modem's radio is switched off: its SIM leaves the mobile network, so calls to a number shared with another SIM reach that phone. The radio is switched off again whenever the modem reconnects, also after a restart.
modem.actions_disabled: This modem is disabled, so its driver keeps its radio off. {stop} releases the modem from the driver: after its next restart it would register on the network again. To use the modem, enable it instead.
modems.title: Modems
modems.uac_quectel: UAC audio only works with the quectel driver
modems.assigned_linked: Modem {id} was created. Phones {phones} now dial out through it and ring for its calls
modems.id_hint: Lower case letters, digits and _, up to 16 characters. It becomes the device name and cannot be changed later.
modems.id_invalid: The id must start with a letter and hold only lower case letters, digits and _ (up to 16).
modems.imei_hint: 15 digits; the drivers find the modem by it.
modems.port_hint: The kernel USB port, e.g. 1-1.3. Scan fills it in; UAC audio needs it.
modems.device_gone: Device {device} is not among the free ones any more — run a scan or enter it by hand.
modems.no_devices_hint: Run a scan, or enter the IMEI of the modem by hand.
modem.settings_hint: The fields of config/aster.yaml; Save applies them to Asterisk.
modem.id_fixed: The id names the device in Asterisk and cannot be changed; a rename is a delete and an assign.
modem.ring_no_phones: No phone is configured yet — add one under Phones.
modem.ring_timeout_invalid: A whole number of seconds from 1 to 3600.
modem.incoming_context_hint: Empty: the generated ring group. A name of your own must exist in extensions.conf — the appliance checks it when it applies.
modem.group_hint: The driver's group for outgoing calls; empty means none.
modem.recipients_hint: Off: the default recipients of the settings are notified about this modem.
modem.delete_text: The entry goes out of config/aster.yaml and the driver is told to drop the device. The messages and calls it has already handled stay.
modem.actions_hint: Each one starts an operation; its result appears as a message.
modem.disabled_done: The modem was disabled; its radio is being switched off
modem.when_hint: Gracefully waits for the call on the modem to end.
modem.history_hint: What the event stream reported while this page was open.
modem.history_empty: Nothing has changed since the page was opened.
forwarding.title: Call forwarding
forwarding.hint: Forwarding of voice calls by the operator, as the modem itself reports it.
forwarding.never: The modem has not been asked yet. Check reads the state from it.
forwarding.outcome_ok: The last query did not give a usable answer
forwarding.outcome_timeout: The modem did not answer the query in time
forwarding.outcome_uncertain: The query did not run or gave no verdict
forwarding.number_hint: International format, e.g. +1234567890. Only Set uses it.
forwarding.number_invalid: The number must start with + and hold 6 to 15 digits.
forwarding.always_wins: Always is on, so the other conditions do not apply until it is turned off.
forwarding.reason_conditional: If busy, no answer or unreachable
forwarding.time_hint: How long the phones ring before the operator forwards the call.
ussd.title: USSD
ussd.hint: A code is sent to the network; the answer comes back as a message from the operator.
ussd.code_invalid: A USSD code holds digits, * and #, up to 64 characters.
ussd.waiting: The operator is waiting for your answer: enter the number of an option and press Send. A menu left unanswered closes after a while.
ussd.not_supported: The network does not support this request.
ussd.network_timeout: The network did not answer in time.
at.title: AT command
at.hint: The command goes straight to the modem. Wrong commands can stop it working until it is restarted.
at.timeout_invalid: A whole number of seconds from 1 to 60, or empty.
phones.title: Phones
phones.number_hint: 3 to 6 digits. It is the extension and the SIP account name, and cannot be changed later.
phones.number_fixed: The number is the SIP account name and cannot be changed; a rename is a delete and an add.
phones.label: Name
phones.secret_hint: The password used to connect the phone over SIP. Printable ASCII characters without spaces or semicolons (;).
phones.secret_invalid: Enter 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters without spaces or semicolons (;).
phones.outbound_hint: The modem this phone's outgoing calls go through.
phones.rings_for_hint: The modems whose incoming calls ring this phone. Each modem's page shows the same list.
phones.rings_for_own_context: This modem sends its calls to its own context {context}, so this list is not dialed for it.
phones.context_hint: Empty: the generated context. A name of your own must exist in extensions.conf.
phones.direct_media_hint: The handsets exchange audio with each other; the appliance then no longer hears the call.
phones.connections_unknown: It is not known which phones are connected: {error}
phones.delete_text: The SIP account stops working at once. A phone a modem rings cannot be deleted: clear its Rings for first.
settings.title: Settings
settings.appearance_hint: The language of this interface and the time zone the notifications are stamped with.
settings.timezone_hint: An IANA name, e.g. Europe/Istanbul. Times in the browser are shown in its own zone.
settings.notifications_hint: Who is notified, and about what.
settings.recipients_hint: The chat ids notified about every modem that has no recipients of its own.
settings.chat_id_invalid: A chat id is digits, with a leading - for a group.
settings.alerts: Report a modem or Asterisk being down
settings.alerts_hint: A modem down for more than 5 minutes, or Asterisk unreachable for more than 2.
settings.retention_hint: How long history is kept; older entries are deleted once a day. SMS still being sent are kept.
settings.retention_invalid: A whole number of days from 1 to 3650.
settings.token_hint: It is stored in config/secrets.env and is never shown again.
settings.token_unset: No token is set — nothing is sent
settings.test_hint: One message to a chat id, sent by the queue like any other.
settings.test_queued: A test message to {chat} was queued
settings.password_hint: Changing it ends every session, this one included.
settings.password_changed: The password was changed — sign in again
settings.password_mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same.
settings.about_hint: Versions and state — the things worth quoting when reporting a problem.
settings.backup_hint: Configuration, database and event spool as one archive. It holds the secrets — keep it somewhere safe.
list.invalid: That value does not have the right shape.
list.duplicate: That value is already in the list.
messages.title: Messages
messages.number_hint: In international format, or as the operator expects it.
messages.number_invalid: A number is 2 to 20 digits, with an optional leading +.
messages.retry_text: Its status is "{status}": it may already have reached the recipient, so sending it again may deliver it twice.
messages.delete_text: The SMS and its send attempts will be deleted. If the message has already been delivered, it will remain on the recipient's phone.
messages.delete_in_text: The SMS is deleted from Aster. A copy already sent to Telegram stays there.
messages.purge_title: Delete all failed or uncertain SMS?
messages.purge_title_modem: Delete all failed or uncertain SMS for {modem}?
messages.purge_text: This deletes outgoing SMS messages with the statuses "Failed", "Rejected", "Not delivered", "No delivery report", or "Outcome unknown", along with their send attempts. Other messages are kept. Only the modem filter applies.
messages.clear_title: Delete all SMS in this list ({n})?
messages.clear_text: Every SMS the list shows with its filters is deleted, on all pages. An SMS still being sent stays.
messages.cleared_kept: SMS messages deleted: {n}. Still being sent, kept: {kept}
messages.no_modem: No modem is configured to send through.
messages.search_hint: The number or a piece of the text.
calls.title: Calls
calls.search_hint: The caller or the number that was called.
calls.delete_text: The call is deleted from Aster.
calls.clear_title: Delete all calls in this list ({n})?
calls.clear_text: Every call the list shows with its filters is deleted, on all pages.
config.title: Configuration
config.pick: Pick a file on the left.
config.generated: Generated from config/aster.yaml — change the modems, phones or settings instead
config.restart_required: Takes effect only after a graceful restart of Asterisk
config.conflict: The file changed on disk since it was opened
config.conflict_text: Someone or something else wrote it. Read it again (this edit is then lost), or apply anyway and overwrite what is there.
config.restart_text: {name} takes effect only after a graceful restart: Asterisk waits for the calls in progress to end and then restarts.
activity.title: Activity
activity.search_hint: The kind of operation or a piece of the error.
activity.notify_search_hint: A piece of the message or of the error.
logs.title: Logs
logs.grep_hint: A plain substring, not a pattern.
logs.truncated: only the end of the file
op.still_running: It is still running — Activity shows how it ends
op.no_operation: The controller did not say which operation it started
toast.apply_slow: The change is taking longer than expected — Activity shows how it ends
live.lost: The event stream broke off — what you see may be stale
error.unauthorized: The session has ended — sign in again
error.not_found_text: This address has no page. Pick a section from the menu.
soon.title: Not built yet
soon.text: This page arrives in a later milestone.
lang.label: Language
